styleLock.direction: editorial rose-flush adaptive foundation commerce, serif headlines and watercolour science
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless warm off-white #F5F3F0 field for packshot, board and science frames, rose-blush split panel #D98A9A carrying white serif type beside a portrait half, pale petal wash #F6E9EC reserved for grid screens, no dark stages
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft editorial beauty light near 5700K, broad diffused key with gentle modelling on the pump shoulder, real skin texture kept visible in comparison crops, shadowless boards, never heavy glow
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte rose cylinder with gloss pump head, thick cream swipe ridges, watercolour pigment bloom on paper, plain studio paper, no marble, no gold trim
styleLock.typography: one high-contrast serif headline in ink #1B1B1E or reversed white, one calm sans for captions, every headline, caption and counter slot kept as an empty placeholder
styleLock.iconSystem: thin white pictogram glyphs on the blush panel left blank of captions, hairline rules trailing ingredient names replaced by empty rails, no stars, no SPF numerals, no certification marks
styleLock.presentationRules: the bottle always shows a blank rose body with no wordmark and the sculpted nozzle exposed or capped beside it, people in comparison and UGC crops are generic with softened identity, swatch drops keep real pigment body, watercolour swirl stays illustrative
noDrift: no customer counts or SPF figures
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent editorial rose-flush adaptive foundation ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of rose bottle #B34A5C, blush panel #D98A9A, warm off-white field #F5F3F0 and ink serif #1B1B1E; soft editorial beauty light near 5700K with a broad diffused key, real skin texture kept visible in comparison crops and shadowless boards; matte rose cylinder, cream swipe ridges, watercolour blooms and plain studio paper only, no dark stages, no marble, no gold trim; one high-contrast serif with a calm sans kept as empty placeholder slots; thin white pictograms without captions and hairline ingredient rails left blank; blank rose bottle body with sculpted nozzle; no color palette changes, no readable lettering, no customer counts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：001 暖白底玫红柱形泵瓶（SMOOCHE 字标/COLOR CHANGING FOUNDATION/15 SPF/30ml 白字）开盖立置，异形按压泵头外露，圆盖侧放右侧；002 暖白场顶部衬线大问句 Will it work on my skin? 与一行说明，下方两排共十四枚由浅到深粉底液色滴；003 同机位同脸 Before/After 双联（面孔清晰），左裸肤右匀净；004 左玫粉分栏白衬线标题 Adapts To Your Skin+三枚白色图标行（自适应/遮瑕/SPF15），右侧模特持瓶贴颊（面孔清晰）；005 白场 The Science 标题与微色素揉开变暖机制说明，中央一尾水彩质感膏体晕染带玫瑰琥珀细点，底部示意图小字；006 Revitalizing ingredients 粉黑双色标题+Glycerin/Mica/Vitamin E 三行名与说明横线，右侧一道乳白微光抹痕+示意图小字；007 Loved by 50.000+ 大标题下四组真人中老年女客 Before/After 双联实拍（面孔清晰，居家窗光）。品类判定依据：主体为自适色遮瑕粉底液泵瓶，L1 美妆彩妆、L2 底妆，leaf 记自适色遮瑕防晒粉底液泵瓶；与提示类目一致。已剥离内容：SMOOCHE 字标与瓶身全部文字、15 SPF、30ml、50.000+ 人数、全部英文标题说明与 Before/After 字样（改空标签片）、成分名与功效行、全部真人面孔身份（柔焦/额部裁切处理为 generic），一律改为空槽/空轨/空计数位/{selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 占位。与同轮 Luxe 变色粉底（粉雾场+墨黑封印章+数据卡）区隔：本套独有玫红瓶身+腮红分栏+水彩机制晕染+前后实拍墙骨架，色板为玫红/腮红粉/暖米白。源图 7 张，逐图一镜排为 7 镜。
